description: Identifies one workflow/capability execution and who/what initiated it.

capability.description: Capability path that is executing, e.g. f/capabilities/collection/web_fetch.
capability.title: Capability

capability_version.description: Version of that capability that is executing.
capability_version.title: Capability Version

conversation_id.description: Hermes conversation/session this execution was requested from, if any.
conversation_id.title: Conversation Id

initiating_actor.description: Who/what initiated this execution: a user id, 'hermes', a schedule name, etc.
initiating_actor.title: Initiating Actor

parent_trace_id.description: trace_id of the execution that spawned this one, if any (e.g. a flow step's sub-run). Absent for a top-level execution.
parent_trace_id.title: Parent Trace Id

request_id.description: Caller-supplied idempotency/correlation key for this specific request, if any.
request_id.title: Request Id

schema_version.description: Schema MAJOR.MINOR this record was written against.
schema_version.title: Schema Version

title: ExecutionContext
